description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of percentage values across different intervals on the x-axis, which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. Each bar represents a specific percentage value within a given interval, with the y-axis labeled "Percentage" and scaled from 0.0 to 0.8. The first bar, corresponding to the interval 0.0 to 0.2, has a height of 11.2%, and is labeled with this value. The second bar, in the interval 0.2 to 0.4, reaches 3.4%, and the third bar, in the interval 0.4 to 0.6, also shows 3.4%. The fourth bar, in the interval 0.6 to 0.8, has a height of 5.8%. The final bar, spanning the interval 0.8 to 1.0, is the tallest, reaching 76.2%, and is labeled with this value. A red dashed vertical line is positioned at the x-value of 0.8, and a red text annotation near the top of the chart indicates the mean value as "mean: 0.82". The bars are displayed in a light blue color, and the chart includes a grid for reference.
